CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
